doc_inconsistencies.detail: build-bootimg.sh:40-45 says keep_bootcon/clk_ignore_unused/pd_ignore_unused were removed, but device/native-bootargs.txt and the release DTB still carry them
device/firmware/README.md claims CS35L41/CS35L63 DSP firmware is included; firmware.manifest has no cirrus/ entries
UCM comment references tools/liuqin-audio-first-sound.sh which does not exist
docs/BUILD.md says no firmware download is published while the repo tracks the full firmware tree
release initramfs ships a730_sqe.fw/gmu_gen70000.bin at legacy qcom/ path; device/firmware uses updates/qcom/ (and initramfs has no vpu blob)
